name: lantern
description: Lantern, a design system for illustrated slides, cut-away machines and buildings, close-up portrait scenes, annotated figures, title and break slides, GIF/MP4 loops and a small UI kit with code tokens, in one style across many colour themes (Black, Blue, Cyan, Gold, Gray, Green, Orange, Purple, Red, Rose, Teal, White, and any colour added from a brand colour), each with a 50-950 shade ramp, dark and light variants, seven type sets and many languages.
